name: Mission 2027: Fast Track (official solo field)
description: The official ADC Mission 2027 'Fast Track' solo autonomous field, laid out from the REC Foundation's Game Element Assembly & Field Setup Instructions v1.0 (08/11/2026).
frame: x = forward along the long mat section (toward the red arch), y = left, z = up. (0, 0) is the drone's start spot, 6 in onto the mat, facing +x.
notes: Positions/heights from the setup PDF: red arch 2' from the start end; landing pad edge on the red arch's tension wire; green keyhole pole 6' from the start end, 2' in from the mat edge, ring bottom 42"; large cube 8' from the start end (near edge); spiral pole 2' from both outside edges of the corner, brackets at 24"/34"/44"; blue arch 7' from the far end of the short section; yellow keyhole pole 3' from that end, 2' in from the edge, ring bottom 19"; tunnel bottom 29" on the yellow pole via a 4" pipe; small cube under the tunnel, 12" from the end.

Estimated (not stated in the PDF): mini keyhole ring size (22" outer / 18" inner), large-cube hole size, which mat edge the green pole's 2' is measured from, and the yellow keyhole's fly-through direction (modelled as heading +x / north, across the short section). Flip 'facing' if your referee reads the figures differently.
Every element may be off by up to +/- 3 in at a real event (manual 1.5).

elements.label: Red arch
elements.hint: 2 ft from the start end of the mat (46 cm ahead of the start spot). Fly under it going forward.

elements.label: Landing pad
elements.hint: Right behind the red arch: its edge touches the arch's tension wire. Center 84 cm ahead of the start.

elements.label: Green keyhole
elements.hint: Pole 6 ft from the start end. Ring bottom 42 in (107 cm), center about 145 cm high. Fly through going forward.

elements.label: Large cube
elements.hint: Near edge 8 ft from the start end. In one side, out a different side (25 pts).

elements.label: Mini keyhole 1
elements.hint: Spiral, lowest ring (bracket at 24 in). East side of the spiral pole. Fly through heading forward (north).

elements.label: Mini keyhole 2
elements.hint: Spiral, middle ring (bracket at 34 in). North side of the pole. Fly through heading left (west).

elements.label: Mini keyhole 3
elements.hint: Spiral, top ring (bracket at 44 in). West side of the pole. Fly through heading back toward the start (south).

elements.label: Blue arch
elements.hint: Over the short mat section, 1 ft in from the corner. Fly under it heading right (east).

elements.label: Yellow keyhole
elements.hint: Hangs off its pole by a T-bracket; ring bottom 19 in (48 cm). Across the short section: fly through heading north.

elements.label: Tunnel
elements.hint: On the yellow keyhole's pole, bottom 29 in (74 cm), top 122 cm. Drop through top to bottom.

elements.label: Small cube
elements.hint: Right under the tunnel, 12 in from the end of the short section. Land on it for 10 points.
